title_en: Decision of the Supreme People's Court on Issues concerning the Unified Exercise of the Power to Approve Death Penalty Cases

articles.content_en: 1. Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Several Specific Provisions for Authorizing Higher People's Courts to Approve the Death Penalty for Certain Types of Current Offenders (Date of Issuance: March 18, 1980)

2. Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Several Matters Concerning the Implementation of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on the Approval of Death Penalty Cases (Date of Issuance: June 11, 1981)
3. Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Authorizing Higher People's Courts to Approve Partial Death Penalty Cases (Date of Issuance: September 7, 1983)
4. Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Authorizing the Higher People's Court of Yunnan Province to Approve Partial Death Penalty Cases for Drug Crimes (Date of Issuance: June 6, 1991)
5. Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Authorizing the Higher People's Court of Guangdong Province to Approve Partial Death Penalty Cases for Drug Crimes (Date of Issuance: August 18, 1993)

6. Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Authorizing the Higher People's Courts of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, Sichuan Province, and Gansu Province to Approve Partial Death Penalty Cases for Drug Crimes (Date of Issuance: March 19, 1996)
7. Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Authorizing the Higher People's Court of Guizhou Province to Approve Partial Death Penalty Cases for Drug Crimes (Date of Issuance: June 23, 1997)

8. Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Authorizing Higher People's Courts and the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army to Approve Partial Death Penalty Cases (Date of Issuance: September 26, 1997)
